places.name: Hallasan National Park
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO Biosphere Reserve featuring South Korea's highest mountain, diverse flora and fauna, and scenic hiking trails.

opening_hours.notes: Check weather conditions before hiking.

places.place_tip: Wear sturdy hiking boots and bring water.

places.name: Seongsan Ilchulbong Peak
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, also known as Sunrise Peak, offering breathtaking views and a unique volcanic crater.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning for sunrise.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to avoid crowds and catch the sunrise.

places.name: Manjanggul Lava Tube
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, this lava tube is one of the finest examples of volcanic activity, featuring unique rock formations.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry at 5:30 PM.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes as the ground can be uneven.
places.address: Gimnyeong-ri, Gujwa-eup, Jeju-si, Jeju-do, South Korea

places.name: Jeju Folk Village
places.ai_summary: A cultural village preserving the traditional lifestyle and architecture of Jeju Island, offering a glimpse into the past.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Tuesdays.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for better insights into the culture.

places.ai_summary: A beautiful waterfall located in a scenic area, known for its clear blue water and lush surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed in the late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning photos.

places.ai_summary: A unique waterfall that falls directly into the sea, offering a spectacular view and a refreshing atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Access may be restricted during heavy rains.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the view from the designated observation areas.

places.name: Hamdeok Beach
places.ai_summary: A popular beach known for its clear waters, fine sand, and beautiful sunrise views.

opening_hours.notes: Lifeguard services available during the day.

places.place_tip: Try the local seafood at nearby restaurants.
places.address: Hamdeok-ri, Jocheon-eup, Jeju-si, Jeju-do, South Korea

places.ai_summary: A scenic coastal area known for its beautiful cliffs, clear waters, and the iconic Seopjikoji Lighthouse.

opening_hours.notes: Bring water and snacks, as facilities are limited.

places.place_tip: Visit the lighthouse for panoramic views.
places.address: Seopjikoji, Seongsan-eup, Seogwipo-si, Jeju-do, South Korea

opening_hours.notes: Wear comfortable shoes for walking.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum inside the park for more information on the rock formations.

places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to tea, offering insights into the tea culture of Korea, along with beautiful tea gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Enjoy a cup of tea at the museum café.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed at sunset.

places.ai_summary: A small island off the coast of Jeju, known for its stunning beaches, clear waters, and scenic bike trails.

opening_hours.notes: Ferry schedule may vary, check in advance.

places.place_tip: Rent a bike to explore the island at your own pace.
